description.en: Finish every Training Facility station and confirm mission readiness.
description.ar: Finish every Training Facility station and confirm mission readiness.

description.en: Check ventilation, power and water in the Earth Analog and log the report.
description.ar: Check ventilation, power and water in the Earth Analog and log the report.

description.en: Stop the water leak with zero mistakes: scan, close the valve, then repair.
description.ar: Stop the water leak with zero mistakes: scan, close the valve, then repair.

description.en: Connect the backup power unit and bring the bus back online.
description.ar: Connect the backup power unit and bring the bus back online.

description.en: Bring the water recycling system online and recover usable water.
description.ar: Bring the water recycling system online and recover usable water.

description.en: Recover communications during the analog blackout.
description.ar: Recover communications during the analog blackout.

description.en: Complete every Earth Analog mission, including the emergency drill.
description.ar: Complete every Earth Analog mission, including the emergency drill.

description.en: Leave the lander, survey the terrain and stand up the Mars base.
description.ar: Leave the lander, survey the terrain and stand up the Mars base.

description.en: Cover 500 metres of surveyed ground on foot and by rover.
description.ar: Cover 500 metres of surveyed ground on foot and by rover.

description.en: Stabilise the crew member at the Medical Station (educational simulation).
description.ar: Stabilise the crew member at the Medical Station (educational simulation).

description.en: Extinguish the microgravity fire with zero mistakes: isolate, protect, suppress, verify.
description.ar: Extinguish the microgravity fire with zero mistakes: isolate, protect, suppress, verify.

description.en: Drill and seal your first Martian core sample.
description.ar: Drill and seal your first Martian core sample.

description.en: Analyse and log two samples in the mission science database.
description.ar: Analyse and log two samples in the mission science database.

description.en: Score 85% or better in the Lunar Landing Navigator simulator.
description.ar: Score 85% or better in the Lunar Landing Navigator simulator.

description.en: Compare two periods at the Earth Observation Station and archive the report.
description.ar: Compare two periods at the Earth Observation Station and archive the report.

description.en: Hold at least 60 water and 60 power at the same time after the analog stage.
description.ar: Hold at least 60 water and 60 power at the same time after the analog stage.

description.en: Keep every carried tool at 80% condition or better.
description.ar: Keep every carried tool at 80% condition or better.

description.en: Finish eight missions with two mistakes or fewer in the whole campaign.
description.ar: Finish eight missions with two mistakes or fewer in the whole campaign.

description.en: Reach a Mission Continuity readiness of 85 or higher.
description.ar: Reach a Mission Continuity readiness of 85 or higher.

description.en: Complete all 15 missions across the eight NOVA stages.
description.ar: Complete all 15 missions across the eight NOVA stages.
